// Offline API compilation probe only. No production adapter or authorization.
package sdkprobe
import (
 "context"
 clientv3 "go.etcd.io/etcd/client/v3"
)
// CommitProbe exercises the official builder. Caller is test-only in-memory KV.
func CommitProbe(ctx context.Context, kv clientv3.KV, root string, old []byte, rev int64, next []byte) (*clientv3.TxnResponse,error) {
 return kv.Txn(ctx).If(
  clientv3.Compare(clientv3.Value(root+"binding"),"=","registered-binding"),
  clientv3.Compare(clientv3.Value(root+"head"),"=",string(old)),
  clientv3.Compare(clientv3.ModRevision(root+"head"),"=",rev),
  clientv3.Compare(clientv3.Version(root+"operations/op-id"),"=",int64(0)),
 ).Then(
  clientv3.OpPut(root+"head",string(next)),
  clientv3.OpPut(root+"operations/op-id","receipt-and-command"),
  clientv3.OpPut(root+"requests/request-id/INTENT","request-index"),
 ).Commit()
}
// This object requests current linearizable Range by default; no historical revision.
func CurrentReadProbe(key string) clientv3.Op { return clientv3.OpGet(key) }
type Decision struct { AllowSigning bool `json:"allow_signing"`; RecoveryAuthorized bool `json:"recovery_authorized"`; SigningHistoryComplete bool `json:"signing_history_complete"` }
